main_body: Dark stone/iron pillar shaft with three gold ring ornaments and a wider grey cap and base block at each end
top_band: Light grey band at rows 9-12 on the upper cap, then a darker front block at rows 13-14. The shaft itself has no top.
evidence: Reading down the middle column: black outline at row 8, then a lighter grey top band (rows 9-12), then an abrupt step to the darker cap front (rows 13-14) that overhangs the shaft. The shaft below is a flat front face with a left highlight strip. The cap top is 4 rows of a 12px-wide block, so it reads as a surface rather than a 1-2px rim, but it is a rectangle with rounded corners, not a true ellipse, and there is no distinct front-edge line. Marginal pass.

style.evidence: The grey ramp has about 3-4 steps and the shaft is a large near-flat dark area with only a left highlight strip. The outline is a uniform near-black line around every shape, which gives the sticker look. There is almost no grain, speckle or per-material texture. Next to the stall and well references, with their multi-tone tiles, wood grain and tinted outlines, the tiles carry only 2-4 colours.
